format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (code-behind for .aspx page)
description: This file contains server-side logic for displaying and submitting answers for a student's theory exam in an online examination system. It manages data retrieval from a database, populates UI controls with answer details, and handles submission of marks, along with navigation controls.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Part of OnlineExamSystem namespace; handles displaying and submitting student answers on a web page.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Loads student answer data from database and populates the UI controls upon page load, if session variables are present.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with the new marks, removes the student from the course queue, and navigates to the Admin Course Queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.
